Name: Small Metal Silo (New Buildings)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[color=#00ff00][size=6][center]Small yet large capacity!
It can store twice as much grass as a regular silo![/center][/size][/color]
That's all.

The textures for this mod will be the same as the one we previously created for a mod that changes the look of regular silos.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11928]Small Metal Silo[/url]
If used at the same time, it may become indistinguishable from a regular silo. lol

You can also change the silo capacity (the maximum amount of hay that can be stored) in the ModConfig settings.



Currently, English, Japanese and Chinese are supported.
